AnalysisStatus.description: Status of the AI analysis. Analysis failed is a status, not a lifecycle state (OD-09).
AnalysisStatus.title: AnalysisStatus

EventRole.description: Why an event belongs to an incident. Context events are never treated as malicious.
EventRole.title: EventRole

Incident.description: A group of related events (FR-07, FR-08, FR-11, FR-18 to FR-20, FR-31, FR-42).

confidence.description: Confidence of the latest valid analysis (OD-16); set exactly when analysis succeeded (FR-42).
confidence.title: Confidence

correlation_config_version.description: Version of the correlation configuration that built the incident (contracts 1.2); null = not recorded.
correlation_config_version.title: Correlation Config Version

created_at.description: When the incident was created, UTC.
created_at.title: Created At

events.description: Linked events (FR-08); event IDs are unique.
events.title: Events

first_event_at.description: Timestamp of the earliest event, UTC.
first_event_at.title: First Event At

incident_type.description: C3 classification, read by C5's scenario lookup (OD-20); null = not classified yet.
incident_type.title: Incident Type

last_event_at.description: Timestamp of the latest event, UTC; not before first_event_at.
last_event_at.title: Last Event At

latest_report_id.description: ID of the latest valid AnalysisReport; required when analysis succeeded.
latest_report_id.title: Latest Report Id

risk.description: Deterministic risk assessment; null = not scored yet.

split.description: Set when the incident is one part of a group that correlation split (contracts 1.2); null = not split.

updated_at.description: Last change, UTC; not before created_at.
updated_at.title: Updated At

Incident.title: Incident

IncidentEntities.description: Distinct host, user and IP values of the incident's events, flagged and context.

ips.description: Source and destination IPs, sorted, unique.
ips.title: Ips

IncidentEntities.title: IncidentEntities

IncidentEventLink.description: Link from an incident to one event (FR-08).

link_keys.description: Keys that linked the event. Empty only for the event that started the incident.
link_keys.title: Link Keys

linked_at.description: When the event was linked, UTC.
linked_at.title: Linked At

role.description: flagged, or context: an unflagged or unlabelled event that shares an entity in the window (OD-02). A context event is never treated as malicious.

IncidentEventLink.title: IncidentEventLink

IncidentSplit.description: This incident is one part of a group that correlation split (contracts 1.2, additive).

cap.description: The size cap in force: most linked events per incident.
cap.title: Cap

gap_seconds.description: Length of the time gap the group was cut at, just before this part; null for part 1.
gap_seconds.title: Gap Seconds

group_id.description: ID the whole group would have had; the same for every part (it is the ID of part 1).
group_id.title: Group Id

part.description: Which part this is, 1 = earliest, in time order.
part.title: Part

parts.description: How many parts the group was split into.
parts.title: Parts

IncidentSplit.title: IncidentSplit

IncidentStatus.description: Lifecycle state (FR-31, TD-11). new replaces the former name Detected.
IncidentStatus.title: IncidentStatus

IncidentSummary.description: GET /incidents/{incident_id}, and one item of GET /incidents.

recommended_scenario_id.description: C5's catalogue recommendation once the analysis is recorded; else null.

IncidentSummary.title: IncidentSummary

LinkKey.description: The entity key that linked an event to the incident (NFR-SF-05).
LinkKey.title: LinkKey

RiskAssessment.description: Deterministic risk score computed by C3 code, never by the LLM (OD-04, OD-05, FR-18).

computed_at.description: When the score was computed, UTC.
computed_at.title: Computed At

confidence_versions.description: Versions behind the event confidence C (contracts 1.4): classifier, calibrators, stacker, LLM model and prompt; empty for a risk-v0 score.
confidence_versions.title: Confidence Versions

config_version.description: Version of the weights and thresholds file used.
config_version.title: Config Version

level.description: Level from the configurable thresholds (FR-20); enforced by C3's scoring code, not by this contract.

phase.description: risk-v1 scoring phase (contracts 1.4): initial before the LLM opinion, final after it; null for a risk-v0 score.
phase.title: Phase

top_contributors.description: The strongest evidence groups, strongest first (contracts 1.1).
top_contributors.title: Top Contributors

RiskAssessment.title: RiskAssessment

RiskContributor.description: One evidence group behind the score: its strongest event (contracts 1.1).

entity.description: Source-side entity of the group, or none.
entity.title: Entity

event_id.description: ID of the group's strongest flagged event.
event_id.title: Event Id

strength.description: Strength of the group's strongest event, 0 to 1.
strength.title: Strength

technique.description: Attack type of the group; unknown when missing.
technique.title: Technique

RiskContributor.title: RiskContributor

RiskFactor.description: One factor of the deterministic risk score.

contribution.description: Points this factor adds to the score.
contribution.title: Contribution

name.description: Factor name from the risk configuration.
name.title: Name

reason.description: Plain-language reason for the factor's value (contracts 1.1, additive).
reason.title: Reason

weight.description: Weight of the factor in the configuration.
weight.title: Weight

RiskFactor.title: RiskFactor

RiskFlag.description: Something the score had to assume because the data does not say (contracts 1.1).
RiskFlag.title: RiskFlag

RiskLevel.description: Risk level derived from the score by C3's configurable thresholds (FR-20).
RiskLevel.title: RiskLevel

ScenarioId.description: Simulated response catalogue v0 (OD-20). Anything else is rejected (FR-44).
ScenarioId.title: ScenarioId

SplitReason.description: Why correlation cut one group of related events into several incidents (contracts 1.2).
SplitReason.title: SplitReason
